info.title: OpenMesh Bridge API
info.summary: Local REST control API for an OpenMesh bridge (v0.7.0, resilience + AI-native operations).
info.description:
The bridge daemon owns identity, radios, the message store and backbone mode. This document is normative for the REST surface; the WebSocket catalog (`/api/ws`) is documented in docs/architecture/WEBSOCKET-API.md and backbone protocol details in docs/architecture/BACKBONE.md.

Authentication: every route except `GET /api/health` (and the HMAC-signed inbound gateway webhook `POST /api/gateways/{id}/inbound`) requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token file `~/.config/openmesh/bridge-token`, mode 0600). The WebSocket also accepts `?token=` because browsers cannot set headers. The API is loopback-only by default; do not bind it to a network interface.

Attribution: mutating calls may send `X-OpenMesh-Agent: <name>` (MCP does this automatically) or `X-OpenMesh-Client: web|cli`; the bridge records them in `GET /api/activity`. Read calls are not logged. Errors are JSON with `error`, `code`, `message` and a `help_topic` slug.

v0.7.0 adds authenticated webhook gateways (`/api/gateways*`, `remote-operations.md` §2) and multiple outbound backbone links (`/api/backbone/links*`, `remote-operations.md` §3).

patch.description: Same semantics as the WebSocket `set_config` command; applies to the running bridge without a restart where possible. post.summary: Send one signed test payload to the outbound webhook
post.description: POSTs `{event:"test",connector,text,timestamp_ms}` with `X-OpenMesh-Signature` over the raw body (single attempt, no retries) and returns the adapter's HTTP status. Token authenticated; recorded in the activity log.

404.description: Unknown connector or no outbound webhook

post.summary: Inbound webhook: inject one signed channel message
post.description: Authenticated with `X-OpenMesh-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, raw body)>` using the connector's `inbound.secret_env` (NOT the bridge bearer token), verified in constant time. Body `{text, from, timestamp_ms}`; `text` is required and limited to `max_chars`, requests are rate limited to 30/minute. `from` is display-only attribution from the adapter and never an identity claim: the injected message is signed by this bridge. Bad signature/missing secret -> 401, unknown connector or disabled inbound -> 404, over-length/invalid JSON -> 400, rate limit -> 429; nothing is injected on any error. Successful injection is audited.

from.description: Display-only sender label, e.g. a phone number.

401.description: Missing/invalid signature or unset secret (no injection)

404.description: Unknown connector or inbound disabled (no injection)

429.description: More than 30 authenticated inbound requests/minute for this connector

get.summary: List outbound backbone links with per-link status
get.description: One entry per persisted link (`<data-dir>/backbone-links.json`). Bearer tokens are redacted as `token=redacted`.

put.summary: Add or update one outbound backbone link
put.description: Persists the link in `backbone-links.json` (mode 0600) and (re)starts its reconnect loop. `enabled:false` keeps the entry without dialing. The legacy single-link `join` path manages the link named `default`.

delete.description: Stops the link's reconnect loop and deletes it from `backbone-links.json`.
